title: Mid-Year Clearance Flash Sale Campaign — Digital-First Retail Push
objective: Drive foot traffic and online sales during school holidays by positioning the brand as the go-to destination for affordable fashion. Target 25% sales uplift over 4 weeks via paid social, influencer amplification, and organic content.
target_audience: Female shoppers aged 18–35 (students, young professionals, mothers); price-conscious fashion hunters in Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw.
key_activities: 3× daily social media posts (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook) showcasing clearance items with trending audio and discount hooks.
5 micro-influencer partnerships (50K–200K followers each) creating unboxing and styling videos.
Meta/TikTok paid ads (carousel + video format) targeting lookalike audiences of past buyers.
Weekly live shopping session (Instagram/Facebook Live) with in-store staff demoing outfits.
SMS/WhatsApp broadcast to existing customer base with exclusive flash-sale codes (daily 48-hour drops).
kpis: Ad spend ROAS ≥ 2.5 (revenue/ad spend)
Peak daily influencer content reach: 800K+ impressions
Email/SMS click-through rate ≥ 12%
Store foot traffic increase: +35% week-on-week (via foot-counter data)
New follower acquisition: +2,500 across Meta platforms
why_now: School holidays (mid-July start) drive family shopping trips and youth spending. Heat and humidity peak — inventory clearance urgent. Influencer season amplifies organic reach when education/work drops off.
deliverables: 84 daily social posts (28 posts × 3 platforms)
5 influencer video deliverables (min. 60s each)
12 paid ad creative variants (image + video carousels)
4 live shopping session briefs + moderation
Custom SMS/WhatsApp copy (8 templates, daily rotation)

title: Mid-Year Fashion & Lifestyle Festival — 2-Day Pop-Up Activation
objective: Build brand awareness and community among Gen Z and millennial fashionistas. Host a 2-day pop-up festival (July 20–21) featuring local designers, live DJs, photo booths, and exclusive merchandise drops. Target 1,500+ foot traffic, 500+ social check-ins, and 300+ email sign-ups.
target_audience: Fashion-forward women 18–32 (students, influencers, content creators); design-conscious urban shoppers in Yangon; Instagram-active millennials.
key_activities: Secure 15–20 local boutique/designer vendors (co-branded booths, revenue share model).
Curate 4-hour entertainment schedule: DJ sets (3×), live fashion show (2 segments), photo booth with AR filters.
Partner with 8 mid-tier fashion/lifestyle influencers for on-site content creation and booth takeovers.
Install branded Instagram photo wall + merchandise display with exclusive launch items.
Email/SMS pre-event teasers (4 weeks prior) + on-site QR-code lead capture for mailing list.
kpis: Total footfall: 1,500+ attendees (day-of headcount + social checkins)
Social media mentions & UGC posts: ≥500 posts tagged (#festival_brand)
Email list growth: +300 opt-ins (capture at entry)
Influencer content reach: 2M+ combined impressions
Post-event survey NPS: ≥7.5/10 (50+ responses target)
why_now: School holidays peak in late July. Perfect timing for youth gathering and brand affinity-building. High engagement season for influencers = amplified reach. Local designers keen to co-promote mid-year.
deliverables: Venue booking (capacity 1,500 pax, Yangon city centre location)
Run-of-show doc (2-day event timeline, vendor briefs, contingency plan)
8 influencer partnership briefs + content direction
1 brand film recap (3–5 min highlight reel, 10-day turnaround post-event)
100× Instagram-branded backdrops & photo booth props
Pre-event email/SMS campaign (4 templates, 2-week send schedule)
Post-event report (attendance breakdown, social analytics, vendor feedback)

title: Brand Refresh Campaign — Relaunch with New Visual Identity & Storytelling
objective: Signal market maturity and expand audience. Relaunch with refreshed logo, colour palette, and brand narrative. Sustained 8-week campaign (July–August) across paid, organic, PR, and in-store touchpoints. Target 10K+ new awareness reach, 30% lift in brand recall among target demographic.
target_audience: Women 20–40 (middle income, fashion-aware, digitally active); existing customers seeking premium positioning; aspirational Gen Z.
key_activities: Develop new brand guideline deck (logo, colour, typography, tone of voice) + internal stakeholder workshop.
Produce 1 hero brand film (90–120s) explaining the rebrand story and values.
Create 16 hero social assets (carousel graphics, reels, static posts) across identity refresh themes.
Coordinate in-store signage refresh (window displays, POS materials, staff briefing).
Secure 2–3 PR placements (Yangon lifestyle/business media) + 1 influencer ambassador launch event (20 key creators).
Launch email nurture series (6 emails over 6 weeks) re-engaging lapsed customers with new brand story.
kpis: Brand awareness reach: 10K+ unique users (paid + organic combined)
Video view-through rate (VTR) ≥40% on hero film (min. 3-sec view)
Social engagement rate (likes+comments+shares): ≥4.5% per post
Email nurture open rate: ≥28%, click-through rate ≥8%
In-store foot traffic increase: +20% post-relaunch (baseline: 4 weeks pre-relaunch)
Brand recall lift (survey): +30% recognition of new visual identity among 200-respondent sample
why_now: July rebrand captures school holidays momentum and sets tone for H2 retail peak. Fresh visual identity energises team and customers mid-year. Influencer season amplifies awareness without heavy paid spend.
deliverables: 1 brand identity guideline document (logo, palette, typography, imagery style, tone of voice)
1 hero brand film (90–120s, 4K, with subtitles MM + EN)
16 social media hero assets (mix of carousels, reels, static graphics across 3 platforms)
3 PR media pitches + 2 confirmed press placements (print/digital coverage)
1 influencer ambassador launch event brief (20 creators, on-site content capture)
In-store signage pack (window displays, 10× POS materials, staff briefing doc)
6-email nurture campaign (design templates, copy, send schedule)
Post-campaign brand audit (awareness survey, recall lift measurement, sentiment analysis)

title: School Holiday Fashion Lookbook & Influencer Content Series
objective: Dominate social feeds during peak school-holiday shopping with a curated influencer-led lookbook series. Commission 12 content pieces across 6 mid-tier influencers (100K–300K followers) showcasing 3 outfit themes (work, casual, party). Target 5M+ impressions, 250+ attributed sales within 4 weeks.
target_audience: Female shoppers 18–32 (students, young professionals); style-conscious social media browsers; gift-givers shopping for family/friends during holidays.
key_activities: Scout and brief 6 fashion/lifestyle micro-influencers (100K–300K MM Instagram followers).
Supply 3 outfit theme packs per influencer (9 pieces total per creator) + styling direction.
Creators produce 2 posts per theme: 1 Reel (60–90s, trending audio) + 1 Carousel (5–8 outfit breakdowns).
Provide unique promo codes per influencer for attribution tracking (e.g., 'CODE_INFLUENCER_NAME').
ZYNTH curates best-performing pieces into 1 brand-owned lookbook article (blog post + Pinterest pins).
Daily monitoring of influencer content engagement + customer feedback; pause/amplify based on data.
kpis: Total influencer reach: 5M+ impressions (tracked via influencer analytics + UTM codes)
Engagement rate across all influencer posts: ≥3.5%
Attributed conversions via unique promo codes: ≥250 orders
Average order value (AOV) from influencer traffic: ≥15K MMK per order
Influencer content save rate: ≥500 saves across all posts (indication of high commercial intent)
why_now: School holidays = peak youth shopping and influencer engagement. Younger shoppers actively seeking style inspiration. Influencer content performs best when audiences have leisure time (holidays).
deliverables: 6 influencer partnership briefs (creative direction, outfit themes, posting schedule, promo codes)
12 influencer content pieces (6 Reels + 6 Carousels, minimum 60s video per Reel)
1 brand-owned lookbook blog post (1,500 words, 15+ outfit combinations, SEO-optimised)
4 Pinterest carousel pins (derived from best-performing influencer looks)
Real-time performance dashboard (daily engagement, reach, conversion tracking)
Weekly influencer performance report (engagement breakdown, attributed sales per influencer)

title: Summer Fashion Startup Launch — 360° Campaign (Event + Digital + PR)
objective: Market entry for new fashion line (budget brand targeting Gen Z). 1-day launch event (July 15) + sustained 6-week digital campaign. Achieve 500 event attendees, 2M+ digital impressions, 400+ email sign-ups, and 150+ first-week sales.
target_audience: Gen Z women 16–25 (students, digitally native, price-conscious); fashion influencers & content creators; style-forward young professionals in Yangon.
key_activities: Host launch gala (150–200 pax) at premium Yangon venue: runway show, DJ, food/beverage, Instagram photo zones.
Invite 15 micro-influencers + 10 media contacts (press, bloggers) for on-site coverage.
Concurrent digital campaign: 1 hero launch video (2 min), 20 teaser posts, 4 paid ad sets (Reels, Stories, Carousels).
Launch dedicated landing page + email nurture (6-email welcome series for list opt-ins).
Post-launch content calendar (8-week): 3 posts/week showcasing bestsellers, customer styling, behind-the-scenes.
1 paid influencer takeover (3 days post-launch) with top-performing event influencer.
kpis: Event attendance: 500+ confirmed guests (invitation + walk-up)
Social media impressions (campaign duration): 2M+ across all platforms
Email list growth: 400+ opt-ins (landing page + event capture)
First-week sales (attributed to launch): 150+ orders, 30M+ MMK revenue
Influencer content reach (on-site + follow-up takeover): 1.5M+ combined impressions
Post-launch website traffic: 25K+ unique visitors over 8 weeks
why_now: School holidays provide ideal foot traffic window. July launch captures peak summer shopping and sets momentum for Q3. Influencer season = amplified earned media. Brand new market entry = maximum newsworthy angle for PR.
deliverables: Event production: Venue (150–200 pax capacity), catering, AV/sound, staging, décor, contingency plan
1 hero launch video (120s, 4K)
20 social teaser assets (15 graphics + 5 short-form videos, 2-week pre-event calendar)
4 paid ad creative sets (15 variants across Meta/TikTok platforms)
1 dedicated launch landing page (mobile-optimised, email capture, product showcase)
6-email welcome nurture series (design templates, copy, 8-week send schedule)
15 influencer brief documents (event attendance + 3-day post-launch content takeover)
3 PR media pitches + 2 confirmed coverage placements (print or digital outlets)
Post-launch content calendar (24 posts, 8-week distribution plan with daily scheduling)
Event recap video (3 min highlight reel, 10-day turnaround)
Launch campaign report (attendance, sales, social metrics, media value, ROI calculation)
